newsitem.title: UK: Life assurer Scottish Widows gets Jersey licence.
newsitem.headline: Life assurer Scottish Widows gets Jersey licence.

text.p: UK mutual life assurer Scottish Widows said on Wednesday it had been granted a licence to establish a life assurance company in Jersey.
Scottish Widows said in a statement the licence had been granted under Jersey's new Insurance Business Law of 1996 and was only the second to be awarded by the States of Jersey Authorities.

Jersey's deputy director for insurance business Nigel Woodroffe said Scottish Widows' decision added to the island's "reputation as a leading international offshore finance centre". He said the move reflected a rapidly expanding insurance sector.
Scottish Widows' group finance director Bill Main said the island provided it with "the foundations on which to build on and expand our business horizons".
